verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS agent platform, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at sierra.ai/llms.txt), and none of the documentation evidence describes docs built for agents to consume. The SDK, Ghostwriter and MCP gateway citations cover building agents, not docs an agent can read.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
